text.description_html:
Acorn IRQBP 10" Forged Iron Square End Door Pull

Perfect for heavy wooden doors, this 10" hand-forged iron art door pull made by Acorn has square mounting ends. Made by hand, with a hammer and anvil, it is formed from iron and has a minimalistic style that harkens back to early European eras. Acorn's IRQBP Iron Art Pull is reminiscent of styles that can be found on century-old wooden doors. Packaged complete with all mounting hardware for thrubolt mounting (bolts through the door) for doors up to 1-3/4" thick. Because it is hand forged in Europe in the old world style of hammer and anvil, each piece will vary slightly.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by using the techniques of the traditional forge. Each piece is fabricated with a rare craftsmanship reminiscent of a time when expert artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into simple yet functional designs. The result is individual works of art made in an old world style. We are proud to offer these high quality pieces to complement your home.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

This is a square mounting end design, we also offer a round mounting end design.

Specifications for the Acorn IRNBP Forged Iron Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 10"
  • Width: 1"
  • Projection: 3-1/2"
  • Bolts through the door for doors up to 1-3/4 inches thick.
  • Material: Hand Forged Iron
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a thrubolt mounting application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
